name: Rhode Island

otherFees.what: eFileRI one-time civil case processing fee to Tyler Technologies, in addition to the court filing fee (revised March 2026)

residency.text: The plaintiff must have been domiciled in and resided in Rhode Island for one year before filing; satisfied instead if the defendant has been so domiciled for one year and is actually served (R.I. Gen. Laws § 15-5-12(a)).

waitingPeriod.text: No divorce judgment becomes final until three months after the trial and decision; the final decree may then be entered ex parte within 180 days (R.I. Gen. Laws § 15-5-23(a)).

simplified.text: No summary procedure found; a three-year separation ground leads to a decision pending entry of final judgment, which may be entered 20 days after the decision (R.I. Gen. Laws § 15-5-3).

uncertain: Family Court divorce filing fee not found: the courts.ri.gov fee documents found (Superior Court fees $160, eFileRI fees) do not cover the Family Court; filingFee null.
